# FMC Media PC 0.2.4

- Arabic Sources now groups each provider and its servers into a separate scrollable column.
- Fasel matching distinguishes anime from live-action titles with the same name (including Death Note).
- Better title normalization and season/part/year checks; genuinely ambiguous works still require a choice.
- Manual work choices are saved locally per provider/title/season and reused for later episodes, including after Fasel mirror changes.
- Selected anime parts are forwarded correctly to providers.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. This release is for Windows x64.
